statement.description: 节点类型 rest/wait/parallel；组合与取值由业务校验
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS step_type varchar(16) DEFAULT 'rest' NOT NULL

statement.description: main 主流程 / finally 清理流程
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS execution_scope varchar(16) DEFAULT 'main' NOT NULL

statement.description: 本任务 main 根 parallel 父节点 ID；根节点为 NULL，业务校验归属与深度
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_step_id integer

statement.description: 仅 wait 使用，固定等待 1～2592000000 毫秒，或 options.wait 动态等待
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS wait_milliseconds integer

statement.description: 仅 parallel 使用，活动子步骤上限 1～8，配置必填
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_concurrency integer

statement.description: 独立请求头绑定数组，仅含 name/binding；名称大小写不敏感且唯一
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS headers jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL

statement.description: 仅 REST 使用且仅保存 text:string；原文不脱敏、不解析、不插值，与 body 绑定互斥；空 text 发送零字节
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS raw_body jsonb

statement.description: 快照节点类型 rest/wait/parallel
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_run_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS step_type varchar(16) DEFAULT 'rest' NOT NULL

statement.description: 快照执行范围 main/finally
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_run_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS execution_scope varchar(16) DEFAULT 'main' NOT NULL

statement.description: 运行父节点 ID；启动事务创建全部节点后第二遍映射，根节点 NULL
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_run_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_run_step_id integer

statement.description: 仅 parallel 父节点保存 REST 汇总：rest_total、pending/running/succeeded/failed/blocked/skipped_count、request_count、response_count、response_time_sum_ms、avg/max/min_response_time_ms；无完整响应时 sum=0、avg/max/min=null，耗时保留三位小数；与子节点终态短事务原子合并，不保存逐请求响应或耗时明细
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_run_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parallel_stats jsonb

statement.description: 已发布到本任务上下文；参数独立赋值，缺失为 null，失败屏障收尾后也发布已赋值；任务组共享发布仍依赖成员及批次成功
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_run_parameters ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS published boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL

statement.description: main/finally/finished；清理结束前 status 保持 running
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_runs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS execution_stage varchar(16) DEFAULT 'main' NOT NULL

statement.description: 主流程第一失败分类，清理失败不得覆盖
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_runs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS primary_error_code varchar(64)

statement.description: 主流程失败摘要，不包含并发子请求响应内容
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_runs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS primary_error_message text

statement.description: pending/running/succeeded/failed/skipped；无 finally 为 skipped
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_runs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cleanup_status varchar(16) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL

statement.description: wait/parallel 无接口绑定，接口字段允许 NULL
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ALTER COLUMN interface_id DROP NOT NULL

statement.description: wait/parallel 无接口绑定，接口字段允许 NULL
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ALTER COLUMN file_id DROP NOT NULL

statement.description: wait/parallel 无接口绑定，接口字段允许 NULL
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ALTER COLUMN version DROP NOT NULL

statement.description: 执行树范围、父节点、兄弟排序索引
statement.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_task_steps_task_scope_parent_position ON task_steps (task_id, execution_scope, parent_step_id, position, id)

statement.description: 执行树范围、父节点、兄弟排序索引
statement.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_task_run_steps_run_scope_parent_position ON task_run_steps (run_id, execution_scope, parent_run_step_id, position, id)

statement.description: 显式鉴权、条件、参数更新、动态等待及负向路径查询策略
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS options jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL

statement.description: 固定等待毫秒扩展为 bigint，支持最长 30 天
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_steps ALTER COLUMN wait_milliseconds TYPE bigint

statement.description: 运行时受限表达式参数来源；与 rest_source 独立，复制和快照保留节点引用
statement.sql: ALTER TABLE task_parameters ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS expression_source jsonb
